Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid username 3. Enter valid password 4. Click Login
Expected result: User is logged in and lands on the secure page with a success message

Title: Login by pressing Enter in the password field
Steps: 1. Enter valid username and password 2. Press Enter instead of clicking Login
Expected result: Form is submitted and user is logged in

Title: Login with valid username and wrong password
Steps: 1. Enter valid username 2. Enter wrong password 3. Click Login
Expected result: Login rejected with a generic error; user stays on login page

Title: Login with unknown username
Steps: 1. Enter a username that does not exist 2. Enter any password 3. Click Login
Expected result: Login rejected with a generic error; user stays on login page

Title: Error message does not reveal whether the username exists
Preconditions: One valid and one unknown username
Steps: 1. Submit valid username + wrong password 2. Submit unknown username + any password 3. Compare the two error messages
Expected result: Both attempts show the same generic message (no user enumeration)

Title: Empty username and empty password
Steps: 1. Leave both fields empty 2. Click Login
Expected result: Validation message shown; no login

Title: Empty username, valid password
Steps: 1. Leave username empty 2. Enter password 3. Click Login
Expected result: Validation message shown; no login

Title: Valid username, empty password
Steps: 1. Enter username 2. Leave password empty 3. Click Login
Expected result: Validation message shown; no login

Title: Username letter case handled as specified
Steps: 1. Enter username with different letter case 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login
Expected result: Behaviour matches the requirement (accepted or rejected consistently)

Title: Leading/trailing spaces in username
Steps: 1. Enter ' username ' with spaces 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login
Expected result: Input is trimmed or rejected consistently; no server error

Title: Very long username (boundary)
Steps: 1. Enter a 256+ character username 2. Enter any password 3. Click Login
Expected result: Graceful rejection; no crash or stack trace

Title: Password field masks input
Steps: 1. Type in the password field
Expected result: Characters are masked

Title: SQL injection in username
Steps: 1. Enter ' OR '1'='1 as username 2. Enter any password 3. Click Login
Expected result: Login rejected; no database error shown

Title: Script injection in username
Steps: 1. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> as username 2. Click Login
Expected result: Input is escaped; no script runs

Title: Account lockout after repeated failed attempts
Steps: 1. Submit the wrong password 10 times in a row 2. Submit the correct password
Expected result: Account is temporarily locked or throttled; correct password is also blocked during lockout

Title: Secure page cannot be opened by direct URL when logged out
Steps: 1. Paste the secure page URL directly into the browser
Expected result: User is redirected to the login page

Title: Logout ends the session
Steps: 1. Click Logout
Expected result: User returns to login page

Title: Back button after logout does not show the secure page
Steps: 1. Click the browser Back button
Expected result: Login page stays; secure content is not shown

Title: Session expires after inactivity
Steps: 1. Stay idle for the session timeout 2. Refresh the secure page
Expected result: User is sent to login page

Title: Tab order and Enter/Tab keyboard navigation
Steps: 1. Use Tab to move through the fields and button
Expected result: Logical order: username, password, Login

Title: Error message is visible and readable
Steps: 1. Trigger a failed login
Expected result: Error is clearly shown near the form

Title: Login page over HTTPS
Steps: 1. Load the login page 2. Check the address bar
Expected result: Page is served over HTTPS
